body:
TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget (internal/gateway, codex_images_test.go:359) fails standalone on current main 2374ffe1, macOS darwin/arm64, sandbox HOME with pinned caches:

    --- FAIL: TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget (0.02s)
        codex_images_test.go:359: turn 2 made 19 of 30 images, with 10 kept
        codex_images_test.go:359: turn 3 made 19 of 30 images, with 10 kept
    FAIL

Reproduce: `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run '^TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget$' -count=1` at 2374ffe1 (fetched today). It also went red under a full `go test -tags nogui ./...` run. Failing the same on main and not caused by the in-flight library PR; filing per 'a red gets its own issue' so it has an owner.
title: gateway: TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget is red on main (turn makes 19 of 30 images)
